steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS1 ToyStoryRacer PAL SLES-03398 Spanish/Italian/Dutch CUE/BIN; two known dump variants and guarded corrupt-track fixes are described upstream. First run creates local tsr_data; never redistribute it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Upstream describes a standalone release ZIP and owned-disc first-start extraction into tsr_data, plus PSXRecomp/launcher source route. No package integrity was checked here; game-derived/runtime distribution review remains separate.
